accepted_bound.to_numpy_extraction: <= 0.5 ms absolute on the 20k x 5 fixture (observed 0.072 ms); the large relative increase is accepted because DataArray.values returned a zero-copy view while the frame path returns a fresh C-contiguous copy, and the absolute cost is negligible

notes: No regression beyond the accepted bound. The only relative regression is to_numpy extraction, whose absolute cost (0.072 ms for 100k values) is immaterial against the model-evaluation work it feeds, and which trades a zero-copy view for a safer independent copy. Construction is faster for 2D and within bounds for 3D; wide-to-long conversion is dramatically faster.
